description: This source file defines the Sum class, which computes the sum of numerical values for statistical analysis. It includes methods for incrementally updating the sum, evaluating the sum over array segments, handling weighted sums, copying instances, and maintaining internal state. It extends an abstract class for univariate statistics and implements Serializable, suggesting its use in a larger statistical or data processing library.
